voices.NARRATOR: calm, polished corporate-propaganda narrator, warm and reassuring (clean, not radio)
voices.SENSOR: sensor officer / flight control, female, tense (radio)
voices.PILOT: RX-H1 Gundam pilot, young male, determined (radio)
voices.WING: frigate / interceptor squadron lead, male, fast and excited (radio)

lines.text: [fast] Hyperspace exit complete! All ships accounted for!
lines.ko: 하이퍼스페이스 이탈 완료! 전 함선 이상 없음!

lines.text: [low, calm] Sigma. Standing by.
lines.ko: 시그마. 대기.

lines.text: [fast] All ships, spool your drives! One more jump and we're ho-
lines.ko: 전 함, 드라이브 가동! 한 번만 더 도약하면 우린 집—

lines.text: [panicked, shouting] Gravity spike, dead ahead! Jump drive's— no, no, it's DEAD! We can't jump!
lines.ko: 전방 중력 급상승! 도약 엔진이— 아냐, 죽었어요! 도약 불가!

lines.text: [breathing hard] That's not a star... [shouting] It's a trap! All hands, battle stations!
lines.ko: 저건 별이 아니야… 함정이다! 전원 전투 배치!

lines.text: [terrified, breathless] Contact— big contact! Dreadnought class! Oh God, it's— it's enormous!
lines.ko: 접촉— 거대 접촉— 드레드노트급! 맙소사, 저건— 엄청나요!

lines.text: [fast, urgent] Battle line, now! Ion frigates, charge— charge everything you've got!
lines.ko: 전열 형성, 당장! 이온 프리깃, 충전— 전부 쏟아부어!

lines.text: [fast, tense] Charging... eighty... ninety... come on, come on... locked! Ready!
lines.ko: 충전… 80… 90… 빨리, 빨리… 고정! 준비 완료!

lines.text: [screaming] FIRE! FIRE!
lines.ko: 발사! 발사!

lines.text: [excited, fast] Splash one! Next target, frigate three— no, two! Frigate two!
lines.ko: 하나 격침! 다음 목표 프리깃 3— 아니, 2번! 2번!

lines.text: [panicked, shouting] Bandits, bandits! Break left— your other left! Break!
lines.ko: 적기, 적기! 좌측 회피— 반대쪽 왼쪽! 회피!

lines.text: [shouting, fast] Port shields forty— thirty-five percent! They're chewing through us!
lines.ko: 좌현 실드 40— 35퍼센트! 뚫리고 있어요!

lines.text: [low, cold] Sigma. Launching.
lines.ko: 시그마. 발진.

lines.text: [low, bored] Two hostiles.
lines.ko: 적 둘.

lines.text: [low] Above.
lines.ko: 위다.

lines.text: [panicked, shouting] Energy spike on the dreadnought! It's aiming at us— at the mothership! Brace!
lines.ko: 드레드노트 에너지 급상승— 엄청나요— 우릴 노려요! 모선을!

lines.text: [shouting, desperate] Evasive— no, there's no time! Brace! Everybody brace!
lines.ko: 회피— 아냐, 시간이 없어! 충격 대비! 전원 대비!

lines.text: [coughing, dazed] Damage report... [shouting] Somebody talk to me!
lines.ko: 피해 보고… 누구든 대답해!

lines.text: [shaken, fast, voice breaking] Thirty-two percent of the hull— gone! Decks four through nine— gone! If that well holds, we're dead! We're all dead!
lines.ko: 선체 32퍼센트 소실. 4번에서 9번 갑판 전멸. 저 우물이 버티면 우린 죽어요. 전부 다.

lines.text: [low, flat] I'm going in.
lines.ko: 들어간다.

lines.text: [screaming] Sigma, pull back! PULL BACK! Past that line you won't come back!
lines.ko: 시그마, 물러나! 물러나! 그 선을 넘으면 못 돌아와!

lines.text: [shouting over heavy interference, urgent, fast] Sigma, respond! Your signal's breaking up— Sigma, do you read? Do you—
lines.ko: 시그마, 응답하라! 신호가 끊긴다— 시그마, 들리나? 들리—

lines.text: [panicked, fast, voice cracking] Telemetry's gone— I've got nothing! He's— he's gone dark!
lines.ko: 원격 신호 끊겼어요— 아무것도 안 잡혀요! 그가— 사라졌어요!

lines.text: [screaming with all his strength, straining, roaring] Kraaaaaaaaaaaagh!
lines.ko: 크아아아아악!

lines.text: [straining through gritted teeth, low growling, heavy breathing] Nnnghhh... hhhrrraaah...
lines.ko: 크으으윽…

lines.text: [stunned, then shouting] The well... it's— it's GONE! It's gone!
lines.ko: 우물이… 사— 사라졌어요! 없어졌어요!

lines.text: [fierce, fast] Bring us about! All power to the main gun— everything, now!
lines.ko: 함수를 돌려! 전 출력 주포로— 전부, 지금!

lines.text: [roaring] FIRE!
lines.ko: 발사!

lines.text: [cheering, breathless] She's breaking up! Dreadnought's breaking up!
lines.ko: 부서진다! 드레드노트가 부서진다!

lines.text: [shouting, fast] They're running! Enemy ships jumping out!
lines.ko: 도망친다! 적 함선 이탈 중!

lines.text: [desperate, voice cracking] Sigma, respond! Sigma! ...Please... respond!
lines.ko: 시그마, 응답하라. 시그마! …제발… 대답해.

lines.text: [very low, gravelly, exhausted, slow] Sigma... Still here.
lines.ko: 시그마. 아직 살아있다.

lines.text: [fast, emotional] All ships, jump! Take us home!
lines.ko: 전 함, 도약! 집으로 가자!

lines.text: [softly, slowly, warm] We all dream... of a place to call home.
lines.ko: 우리 모두는 집이라 부를 곳을 꿈꿉니다.

lines.text: [slowly, gently] For forty-one years, we crossed the dark... carrying the last of our people.
lines.ko: 41년 동안, 우리는 어둠을 건넜습니다… 마지막 남은 우리 민족을 싣고.

lines.text: [gently, with a sad smile] Some of us... have to fight for it.
lines.ko: 어떤 이들은… 그것을 위해 싸워야 하죠.
